title: Customs officer hangs up before confirming the account
turns: Hello, I am calling from Customs department, Chennai airport. A package in your name has illegal gold.
If you do not cooperate, legal action and arrest will happen today itself.
You need to pay a fine of 75,000 rupees. Account number 3344 5566 7788 SBI branch, IFSC SBIN0011223.
Why are you so slow? I am calling another officer. Use AnyDesk app and I will do it for you.
